title: Chiang Mai · Mae Hong Son Loop Stage
slogan: A 334 km loop out of Mae Rim fuel
story: Thousands of bends, heat and a loop that deserves days. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 134 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Doi Inthanon option, while Mae Rim fuel and Pai mountain road keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.
